nodes.name: Tuesday 06:00 America/Los_Angeles
nodes.notes: THE CLOCK. The cron is plain (0 6 * * 2 = Tuesday 06:00) and the timezone comes from the workflow settings above, which are set to America/Los_Angeles. Do not put a UTC offset in the expression: DST would silently move the poll by an hour twice a season, in the middle of it. WHY TUESDAY AND NOT SUNDAY: the 2026 FBS schedule has week 1 finishing on Labor Day MONDAY (SMU at Florida State, 16:30 PT, 2026-09-07), and every other week finishing with a Hawai'i nightcap that kicks 20:59 PT and ends after midnight. Tuesday 06:00 PT is the earliest weekly slot at a sane hour that clears every one of them, and it still lands ten hours before the earliest game of the next week (Tuesday MACtion, 16:00 PT).

nodes.name: Dispatch weekly.yml
nodes.notes: POST /repos/vyhlidal/cfb-poll/actions/workflows/weekly.yml/dispatches. Success is HTTP 204 with an empty body. The workflow FILE NAME works as the {workflow_id} path segment, which is why nothing here has to look up a numeric id. Retries three times because a transient GitHub 5xx on the one clock that matters is worth three seconds of patience.

meta.description: THE PRIMARY CLOCK for the weekly poll (ADR 0002, moved to Tuesday 06:00 America/Los_Angeles on 2026-08-17). Two nodes, no daemon, no port, no TLS, no database. Import, attach the credential, do NOT activate until ops/arming.toml has `n8n = true` on main - the GitHub side no-ops until then, so activating early costs a wasted dispatch rather than a bad publication, but there is no reason to spend it. Runbook: docs/runbooks/sunday-automation.md
